name: security-guidance (official plugin)
summary: Official plugin whose hooks check edits for insecure patterns. Hold on Windows, where its hooks fail or loop on many setups; the ledger says Assess on other platforms, so setup offers it nowhere. Its hooks run on every edit and are advisory by the vendor's own definition.
